basic_details.scholarship_name: Rice University Computer Science Graduate Fellowship & Assistantship
basic_details.offering_entity: Rice University (George R. Brown School of Engineering - Department of Computer Science)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Rice University Main Campus (Houston, Texas, USA)
degree_levels: Doctor of Philosophy (PhD in Computer Science)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Restricted to doctoral candidates in Computer Science: Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, High-Performance Computing, Systems, Computer Security, Programming Languages, and Theoretical Computer Science.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: 100% of admitted PhD students receive guaranteed full financial support (~35 to 45 doctoral students admitted annually)
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open global competition; typically 2 to 4 talented Pakistani students admitted per year
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Guaranteed 5-year full doctoral funding package (tuition waiver + 12-month living stipend + medical insurance subsidy)

nationality_requirements: Open to international and domestic applicants holding a valid passport
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (BS) or Master's degree (MS) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, or closely related STEM field from an HEC-recognized university with high academic distinction (minimum cumulative GPA of 3.50 / 4.00; competitive admits typically 3.75+ / 4.00).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Rice Graduate Division requires minimum 3.0/4.0; competitive computer science applicants generally exceed 3.70 on a 4.0 scale.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Strong coursework in data structures, algorithms, operating systems, computer architecture, linear algebra, and discrete mathematics.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Students in their final undergraduate or master's year can apply; degree completion required before August matriculation.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Peer-reviewed research publications or major contributions to open-source software strongly preferred.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: TOEFL iBT min 90, IELTS Academic min 7.0, or Duolingo min 115. Medium of Instruction letters not accepted.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; instruction and research conducted entirely in English.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: None; diversity and women in computing initiatives actively encouraged.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Top candidates nominated for Rice Graduate Fellowships and Brown School Dean's Fellowships.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: External fellowship holders receive institutional top-up awards.

tuition_fee.details: Full tuition waiver covering 100% of Rice University graduate engineering tuition (~USD 58,000 / year value).

admission_application_fee.details: Rice University CS graduate application fee of USD 85 paid online via credit card.

accommodation.details: Paid from monthly living stipend; graduate apartments near Rice campus in Houston (Museum District, Medical Center, Rice Village) average USD 750 to 1,100/month for shared housing.

monthly_stipend.details: Guaranteed 12-month annual living stipend of USD 36,000 to USD 40,000 / year (~USD 3,000 to 3,333 / month; ~PKR 840,000 to 933,000 / month) provided via Graduate Research Assistantships (GRA) or Teaching Assistantships (TA).

airfare.details: International travel between Pakistan and Houston George Bush Intercontinental (IAH) / Hobby (HOU) is self-funded.

visa_fee.details: US F-1 Visa fee (USD 185) and SEVIS I-901 fee (USD 350) paid to US government.

health_insurance.details: Rice Student Health Insurance Plan (Aetna) fully subsidized for doctoral fellows (~USD 3,600 / year value).

food_allowance.details: Living and groceries costs covered comfortably by the 12-month doctoral stipend in affordable Houston.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: High-performance GPU computing clusters, lab workstations, and software tools provided by CS department.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Departmental and advisor travel funds cover registration, airfare, and hotel costs (USD 1,200 to 2,500 per conference) for presenting accepted papers at leading conferences.

travel_transit_allowance.details: METRO Q-Card discounted transit and free Rice campus shuttles throughout campus and Texas Medical Center.
travel_transit_allowance.amount: Free campus and medical center shuttle transit

university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: 4-year BS or MS in CS/STEM with 3.5+ GPA, 3 letters of recommendation, statement of purpose, CV, and TOEFL 90+ or IELTS 7.0+. GRE is optional.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: AI/ML and data science attract highest applicant volumes; high-performance computing, systems, compilers, and theory offer higher admission likelihood for well-prepared applicants.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Duncan Hall hosts the Ken Kennedy Institute; identify 2-3 faculty members whose recent papers you have read and reference their specific research directions.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the Rice ApplyWeb portal, select Department of Computer Science (PhD), choose faculty mentors, and upload application materials.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (September - November): Review faculty research groups in Duncan Hall and identify potential advisors.
Step 2 (October - December): Create profile on the Rice ApplyWeb graduate portal.
Step 3 (November - December): Upload statement of purpose, CV, transcripts, and register 3 academic references.
Step 4 (By 15 December): Submit application and pay USD 85 application fee.
Step 5 (January - February): Faculty review applications and conduct technical video interviews.
Step 6 (February - March): Official PhD offer letters with 5-year guaranteed funding package released.
Step 7 (By 15 April): Confirm acceptance in the portal.
Step 8 (May - July): Receive Form I-20 and apply for US F-1 visa.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated automatic funding: 100% of admitted PhD students are awarded 5-year full funding packages without a separate scholarship application.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Three academic recommendation letters submitted online via the ApplyWeb automated referee system.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of Purpose: 1-2 page essay covering research background, technical interests, faculty alignment, and career aspirations.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Integrated into statement of purpose; focus on concrete research problems, past contributions, and future directions.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing publications, open-source repositories, engineering projects, and technical skills.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Virtual technical interviews (30-45 minutes via Zoom) conducted by prospective faculty advisors evaluating research depth and technical problem solving.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: TOEFL iBT (90+) or IELTS Academic (7.0+) or Duolingo (115+). GRE is optional.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Unofficial scans uploaded for review; official transcripts required upon admission offer.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translations required for non-English credentials.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via the Rice ApplyWeb portal.

required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure professors submit from verified institutional email addresses (.edu.pk).

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Admissions offered for Fall semester only. Hard deadline is December 15.

selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 40% (published research, statement of purpose, technical sophistication, code samples)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 5% (industry research experience or software engineering roles)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (clarity of research goals and alignment with faculty mentors)
selection_process_and_weights.recommendations_weight: 10% (credibility of referees and their specific evaluations of research aptitude)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 5% (alignment with faculty grants and technical performance in video interview)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Rice CS Doctoral Admissions Committee and faculty lab PIs.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Faculty-led holistic review: Candidate files are reviewed by faculty sub-committees, followed by faculty interviews and matching with research grants.

fake_websites_and_scams: Commercial education recruiters charging large sums claiming guaranteed admission or funding at Rice. Admissions decisions are made exclusively by Rice faculty.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Pay the USD 85 application fee only through the official Rice ApplyWeb portal. Never wire money to intermediaries.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Rice strictly forbids the use of admissions agents. Plagiarized statements of purpose result in immediate disqualification.
hidden_costs_breakdown: US F-1 Visa and SEVIS I-901 fees: USD 535 (~PKR 150,000).
Flight ticket from Pakistan to Houston: ~PKR 350,000 to 500,000.
Initial apartment security deposit and living costs: ~USD 1,200 (~PKR 336,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: CLAIM: GRE General Test is mandatory. (FACT: The GRE is optional for Computer Science PhD applicants).
CLAIM: Only students with master's degrees are admitted to the PhD. (FACT: Direct entry from 4-year bachelor's degrees is very common and fully funded).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some online forums report that MS students receive automatic funding. At Rice, guaranteed multi-year funding packages are reserved for PhD students.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain cumulative GPA of 3.00 / 4.00 or higher in all graduate coursework with satisfactory research progress.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research and academic residency on the Rice campus in Houston.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress reviews conducted by the doctoral program committee and faculty advisor.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Graduate research and teaching assistantships are capped at 20 hours per week during academic terms.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None. International graduates qualify for US F-1 OPT with 3-year STEM extension and employer-sponsored permanent residence pathways.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Funding terminates upon withdrawal; past disbursements are not subject to clawback.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Fellowships cannot be transferred to other universities.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing research areas or advisors requires approval from the Department Chair and finding a faculty member with research funding.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Funding is guaranteed for 5 years; extensions into Year 6 are supported via faculty advisor research grants.
